summary: First test of new /the-apartments-ana.html generated by scripts/build_ana.py. Overall PASS: zero horizontal overflow at 375/390/430/768/1024/1440/1920, zero console errors, clean namespace (no 'tac' selectors/vars/ids/classes/data-attrs in Ana html/css/js besides the approved ./media/tac asset paths and the legitimate footer/mega-menu link to the Taç page), correct metadata (title 'The Apartments Ana | Nova Konut', description, theme-color #281B23, body 'page-project page-ana'), correct asset references (only css/the-apartments-ana.css and js/the-apartments-ana.js beyond shared styles.css/script.js/swipe-carousel.js/Leaflet CDN), section rhythm matches spec exactly (plum-dark action strip #281B23, ivory intro/render/plans/parking/nearby #F3EFE7, bone inner panel/specs/arrival #E8E0D4, plum-dark designed-around/location #281B23, plum enquire #3B2632), hero action bar in correct DOM order (view-render, book-unit, view-plan), Ana logo loads (ANA_logo-tight.svg, natural 300px) with a colour filter to blend into ivory, plan lightbox open/close/Escape/print all functional with zero console errors, Leaflet map initialises with darkened tiles and marker (.ana-map-pin), no .leaflet-image-layer, coords 40.977168/29.049069 in the ana-map-link, site-plan figure sits above the map in normal flow (no overlap), enquiry form validation works (empty submit -> 'Please complete your name, email and accept the Privacy Policy.', filled submit -> 'Thank you. Your request has been received...'), project select defaults to 'The Apartments Ana, Bağdat Caddesi', reduced-motion emulation removes all .is-pending and reveals every element (0 pending, 0 hidden). Regression clean: /the-apartments-tac.html, east-west.html, index.html, projects.html, contact.html, construction.html, design.html all load with 0 errors and 0 overflow at 1440.

issues: Computed background-color of .ana-hero is rgb(0,0,0) (pure black). The spec asks for 'no pure black' as a page background. In practice the black is fully covered by the hero video + plum scrim, so it is never visible, but the underlying element still computes to pure black. Consider setting .ana-hero background to --ana-plum-dark #281B23 or --ana-ink #30292B in scripts/ana_palette.css so the computed value is on-palette. Same base rule inherited from the shared Taç base stylesheet, so it also applies to .tac-hero and is not a regression.

aside.side-menu computes to background-color rgb(255,255,255). This comes from the shared css/styles.css (unchanged) so it is out of Ana-page scope, but if a strict 'no pure white anywhere' rule is required it needs to be addressed globally, which is explicitly disallowed by the current problem statement (no global/shared CSS rule may be added). Flagging for awareness only.

action_items: Optional: in scripts/ana_palette.css add `.ana-hero { background-color: var(--ana-plum-dark); }` so the computed hero background is on-palette instead of pure black. Non-blocking - the black is never visible because the hero video + plum scrim cover it.
No other action required. Namespace, structure, palette, interactions, animations, mobile behaviour and regressions all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: scripts/build_ana.py output is clean - no tac-* leakage into class/id/data-attr/CSS variable/JS identifier space.
Enquiry form status element is #anaFormMsg (data-testid=ana-form-message) - future testers should target that, not a generic .form-status class.
Form has novalidate so the JS validator runs correctly on empty submit instead of relying on browser native validation.

Plan lightbox print button is z-ordered under the plan image, so Playwright needs force=True to click it programmatically (real users can still reach it since the image sits below the button in the visible modal layout). Consider raising the print/close button z-index above #anaPlansLightboxImg for robustness.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (1 minor palette nit on .ana-hero computed black bg, everything else passes)

Key selectors: #anaEnquireForm, #anaFormMsg (data-testid=ana-form-message), #anaPlansLightbox, [data-testid=ana-plan-expand|ana-plan-close|ana-plan-print], #anaMap, [data-testid=ana-map-link], [data-testid=ana-view-render|ana-book-unit|ana-view-plan]. Form field names: fullname, email, phone, code, project, source, news, privacy. Only stylistic nit is that .ana-hero computes rgb(0,0,0) (base is from Taç); optionally paint it plum-dark in scripts/ana_palette.css.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs. The only flagged item (.ana-hero pure-black background) originates from the base .tac-hero rule that scripts/build_ana.py renames to .ana-hero verbatim; scripts/ana_palette.css does not override it. Adding an override there is the cleanest fix and does not touch the Taç page.
